description: Change a business card that create_business_card already made: a detail, the design, the color or the quantity. Pass the order link (or the id in it) as order, plus only the fields that change. A field you leave out keeps its current value; a field sent as an empty string is taken off the card. The card keeps the same order link, so the user does not need a new one. Returns the new preview of both sides, the price and the same link, exactly like create_business_card. It works until the card is paid for; after that the card is fixed, and a different card needs a new create_business_card call. Use this for every change the user asks for after the first proof.

accent_color.description: New hex accent color, e.g. '#0E7C66'. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to go back to the design's own color.

address.description: New address. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to take it off the card.

company.description: New company name. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to take it off the card.

email.description: New email address. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to take it off the card.

logo_url.description: New https link to a logo image. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to remove the logo.

name.description: New name. Leave it out to keep the current one.

order.description: The order link returned by create_business_card, or the id inside it.

phone.description: New phone number. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to take it off the card.

quantity.description: New quantity. Leave it out to keep the one already asked for. How many cards the user wants, if they said. There is a minimum order; a smaller number is raised to the minimum and the change is reported in the warnings. With a quantity, the result also gives the shipping options and an estimated total. It is preselected on the order page.

style.description: New card design. Leave it out to keep the current one. classic: White card, dark ink, a thin color rule. Clean and safe for any business. noir: Near-black card with warm gold details and a serif name. Formal, premium. warm: Cream card, espresso ink, terracotta accent and a serif name. Friendly, crafted. bold: Big name over a solid color band that holds the contact details. Modern, confident. center: Everything centered on a white card, with a short rule under the name. Quiet, minimal. sidebar: A solid color panel down the left side, with the details set beside it. Structured, modern. split: The name on white at the left, the contact details on a solid color half at the right. Crisp, balanced. monogram: The initials in a ring beside a serif name, with the contact details in two columns. Personal, classic. stripe: A color stripe across the top that carries the company name, with the name and details below. Tidy, corporate. soft: Lightly tinted paper with a round shape in one corner and a serif name set low. Calm, friendly.

tagline.description: New line for the back of the card. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to take it off.

title.description: New job title. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to take it off the card.

website.description: New website. Leave it out to keep the current one; send an empty string to take it off the card.

name: update_business_card
title: Change a business card
